# `log10`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
log10(expr)
```

Returns the logarithm of `expr` with base 10.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `math_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
SELECT log10(10);
```

Result:

```text
1.0
```
